title: Crew Standard for Haul-Away, Disconnection and Site Connections
content:
**What may be taken away.** On an order under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment an old item is taken away only
where the fulfilment service includes or offers it, and only an item of the same kind as the one delivered: one
refrigerator for one refrigerator, not a second appliance besides.

**Disconnection of the old item.** The old item is disconnected first only where the fulfilment service includes
disconnection. Where it does not, the customer has it disconnected before the crew arrives, or the haul-away is not
carried out.

**Connections on the new item.** Water, waste and gas connections on the new item are made only where the fulfilment
service includes them. A crew that finds the connection unsafe leaves the item in place and records the reason.

**Packaging.** Packaging is taken away with every delivery at no charge, and packaging alone is recorded as such rather
than as a haul-away.

**Where nothing was taken.** Where nothing was taken although the customer asked for it, the haul-away charge is
credited back on the same order line.

## The same standard as condition and result

| At the address | What the standard provides |
| --- | --- |
| the fulfilment service neither includes nor offers haul-away | no old item is taken away |
| an item of a kind other than the one delivered | it is not taken away |
| a further appliance offered besides the item of the same kind | it is not part of the haul-away |
| the service includes or offers haul-away and the item is of the same kind as the one delivered | the conditions this standard sets for a haul-away are met |
| the service includes disconnection | the old item is disconnected first |
| the service does not include disconnection, and the item was disconnected before the crew arrived | the haul-away is carried out |
| the service does not include disconnection, and the item stands connected | the haul-away is not carried out |
| the service includes water, waste or gas connections, and the connection is safe | the connections on the new item are made |
| the connection is found unsafe | the item is left in place and the reason recorded |
| packaging only | taken away at no charge, recorded as packaging |
| the customer asked for a haul-away and nothing was taken | the haul-away charge credited back on the same order line |
